notes: Circuit: 3A current source (#4) drives a ladder. Top rail left-to-right: I-DC top -> R 3K (#1) -> node with C 0.7F (#6) -> R 6K (#2) -> node with R 2K (#5) -> R 8K (#0) -> V-DC 10V (#3) top. Bottom rail left-to-right: I-DC bottom -> C bottom -> GND (#8) -> R 2K bottom -> L 10mH (#7) in series -> V-DC bottom. NET MAP: n3 = left vertical rail: I-DC(#4) top terminal + left lead of R 3K(#1). n4 = top rail between R3K right and R6K left, plus the vertical drop to the top plate of C 0.7F(#6). n1 = top rail between R6K right and R8K left, plus the vertical drop to the top of R 2K(#5) (site S12). n2 = top-right rail: R8K right lead + V-DC(#3) top (+ terminal). n5 = bottom-right: V-DC bottom (- terminal) + right lead of L 10mH; the inductor is in series in the bottom rail so it splits the bottom rail into two nets. 0 = ground rail: I-DC bottom, bottom plate of C 0.7F (site S21), GND symbol stub (site S20), bottom of R 2K (site S19), left lead of L 10mH. JUDGEMENT CALLS / SITES: S12 (650,390) CRITICAL -> junction. The 2K column wire terminates on the horizontal top rail from below: a clean T, no hop, no pass-through ink above the rail. Reading it as a crossing is impossible - it would leave R2K's top on a one-terminal net and cut the 6K/8K rail. S19 (649,585) CRITICAL -> junction. The 2K column wire meets the bottom rail; hop_score 3.6 comes only from a ~6px pen overshoot below the rail (visible in the crop as a short stub), not from a semicircular hop or a sideways jog. Junction is also electrically forced: a crossing would strand R2K's bottom terminal with no return path. S20 (540,586) CRITICAL -> junction. Short vertical stub from the bottom rail down to the GND symbol - a T. The horizontal strokes lower in the crop are the GND symbol's own bars. A crossing would leave GND floating and the circuit with no reference. S21 (437,592) CRITICAL -> junction. The capacitor's bottom lead ends on the bottom rail - a T with no ink continuing below. A crossing would strand C's bottom terminal. S13 (440,399) non-critical -> junction, recorded explicitly: the capacitor's top lead ends on the top rail (T). All other sites (S0-S11, S14-S18, S22, S23) are handwritten value text ('8KO', '3KO', '6KO', '2KO', '0.7F', '3A', '10mH') brushing wire or component ink, or the resistor zigzag ink itself - none of them change the netlist and all are left at the tracer default. Classes all confirmed against the crops: #3 is a circle with +/- = V-DC, #4 is a circle with an up arrow = I-DC, #7 is a coil = Inductor, #5 is a vertical zigzag = Resistor.
